title: Add public /api/health endpoint for uptime pings
body:
## Summary
- Adds `GET /api/health` with `auth: false`, returning `200 {"status":"ok"}`.
- Intended for external uptime monitors (UptimeRobot, cron-job.org) to keep the Render free web service from spinning down.

## Test plan
- [ ] After deploy, `curl https://<render-url>/api/health` returns `200 {"status":"ok"}`.
- [ ] Endpoint is reachable without an API token / JWT.
- [ ] Point an UptimeRobot monitor at the URL, confirm consistent 200s over a few intervals.
